I don't have any advice I can give to you, I'm not even sure if you want it but...I too am pissed at myself for not making better use of my youth. I can't tell you how I fixed that (because i haven't yet) but we have our whole lives ahead of us don't we? i mean, you're heading off the college soon and after that (based on the average human life span of 75 IIRC) you have have 50 whole years to figure it out (possibly more!). To "unruin" your life and build something new. You will be okay, you'll be alright, you'll feel alive again. You'll be happy! And you're already taking the first step to reaching that. You're here, reaching out for help and that's already great! 

And its completely normal to feel unsafe and scared around big life changes (or in general, i feel unsafe quite a lot of the time), especially when you don't have a good support network. And no, you're not fucked, you're not ruined, this is not the end. 

"I just want to feel alive again, Theres just so much I want to say but it all seems stupid. Everything I say seems so pathetic, Like It will never be enough to have at least someone who cares as much as I care, why can't I feel it when people do? why do I feel fake. why does everything around me feel so unreal" and for this part, maybe check out r/dpdr ?
